communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

- The complete bill file for Senate Bill 1072 (2026), the Antisemitism Task Force, including all bill versions, Senate bill analyses and fiscal impact statements, committee vote records, amendments, and any drafting materials, in each case including records not posted on the Senate public website.

- All records, including outside draft language or model legislation, submitted to, received by, or shared with the office of Senator Alexis Calatayud, or with Senate committee staff, in connection with the drafting of Senate Bill 1072, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Email and email attachments between Senator Alexis Calatayud or any member of her legislative staff and any person or organization outside the Florida Legislature regarding the drafting, language, or sponsorship of Senate Bill 1072, including the following words/phrases "Antisemitism Task Force," "International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance," "task force," between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request. Please exclude from this search any email address ending in mfa.gov.il or gov.il, as those records have been the subject of a prior request.

- Calendar entries, meeting invitations, and scheduling records for Senator Calatayud concerning the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC), the "50 States, One Israel" conference held in Israel in September 2025, or the June 2, 2026 launch event in Washington, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request.

- Records of travel, lodging, or expenses paid for, reimbursed to, or arranged for Senator Calatayud in connection with the State Legislators Israel Caucus (SLIC) or the "50 States, One Israel" conference, between January 1, 2025 and the date of this request, including reimbursement forms, expense reports, and travel or gift disclosures, and records identifying the source of funding for that participation.

If any part of these documents are exempt from disclosure, please be sure to review and release all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions of responsive documents, as the law requires.

I request that I be properly classified as a media requester. I am an assistant editor at Reason Magazine who has written numerous articles on topics of public interest, and I am requesting these documents in an editorial capacity. Please contact me if you have any questions about my media status.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
